name: hello_cli
description: Example custom CLI — echoes its input. Replace with your own entries; each entry becomes an agent tool without code changes.

name: watch_agent
description: Block until a workmux agent reaches a status (default 'done'), firing a macOS notification automatically. Input: '<worktree> [status] [timeout-seconds]'. Use from a background sub-agent to watch a dev session; your final report becomes the iMessage notification.
